hypotheses.rationale: Training loss rapidly approaches zero while validation loss shows high variance and rises after epoch 6, indicating overfitting due to excessive epochs for a small dataset (200 train, 50 val).
A LoRA rank of 16 may limit the model's ability to capture the 77‑intent mapping, resulting in poor generalization despite near‑zero training loss.
The fine‑tuning data consists of very short queries, whereas production banking queries may be longer or phrased differently, causing the model to fail on real‑world inputs.
If the training data used a plain prompt format while inference expects a specific chat template, the model may ignore the instruction and produce incorrect labels.
